hero.headline: Apply for Every DSE IPO, Right From Your BO Account
hero.subhead: 100% online, through the Midway Portal. No paper forms, no branch visit.

currentlyOpen.noOpenIpoMessage: No IPO is currently open for subscription. Check back soon, or join the IPO Membership Club below so you never miss one.

whoCanApply.title: General Investor
whoCanApply.description: Any resident retail investor with an active BO Account

whoCanApply.title: NRB
whoCanApply.description: Bangladeshi citizens abroad get a dedicated quota — see lock-in note below

confirmedNote: No minimum prior stock-market investment is required to apply — confirmed per current BSEC rules.

pricingMethods.title: Fixed Price
pricingMethods.description: The company sets one price. You apply at that price.

pricingMethods.title: Book Building
pricingMethods.description: Eligible institutional investors set a "cut-off price" through bidding. You apply at that price — you don't bid yourself.

allocation.note: Per current BSEC rules — the public offer is split into category quotas, which differ by pricing method

howToApply.note: You apply for a 5-working-day window and deposit the full subscription amount upfront. If the IPO is oversubscribed, General Investors and NRBs are allotted by lottery — if you're not selected, your money is refunded to your BO Account.

lockIn.gi: General Investors (GIs): No lock-in. Resident retail investors who receive shares through the public offer have no lock-in period and can trade or sell their shares starting from the first trading day.
lockIn.nrb: Non-Resident Bangladeshis (NRBs) / Non-Residents (NR): 1-Year Lock-In. Shares held under the non-resident quota are subject to a 1-year lock-in period starting from the first trading day at the stock exchange(s).

membershipClub.title: IPO Membership Club
membershipClub.description: Sign up once in the Midway Portal, and we auto-apply to every eligible Equity IPO on your behalf, based on available balance.
